verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents free self-hosting via Docker and a downloadable desktop app that gets an agent running "in minutes." Hands-on users independently report a single-install desktop package, a working setup in under 5 minutes with Ollama auto-detected, and successful installs on standard office PCs. A Linux install hit a chrome-sandbox permission error that needed a manual (and contested) workaround. missing for 10: the actual one-line install command (e.g., docker run or installer script) is not shown in the evidence, and Linux desktop install has a documented permission snag.
